# UD Serbian ParCoLab

Language: [Serbian](/sr/index.html) (code: `sr`)<br/>
Family: IE

This treebank has been part of Universal Dependencies since the UD v2.19 release.

The following people have contributed to making this treebank part of UD: Aleksandra Miletić.

## Description

ParCoLab is a treebank of Serbian based on literary texts. It was originally developed between 2014 and 2018 (original corpus available here).




ParCoLab is based on two works of fiction: "Bašta, pepeo" by Danilo Kiš and "Testament" by Vidosav Stevanović. It was originally annotated in a language-specific annotation scheme (original corpus available [here](https://github.com/aleksandra-miletic/serbian-nlp-resources)). The conversion to UD was done semi-automatically, using conversion scripts, followed by extensive manual checks and corrections. The corpus was developed as part of the [ParCoLab](https://parcolab.univ-tlse2.fr/en/) project.

<h3>Auxiliary Verbs and Copula</h3>

<ul>
<li>This corpus uses 2 lemmas as copulas (<a>cop</a>). Examples: biti, bivati.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>This corpus uses 3 lemmas as auxiliaries (<a>aux</a>). Examples: biti, hteti, bivati.</li>
</ul>

<h3>Relations Overview</h3>

<ul>
<li>This corpus uses 6 relation subtypes: <a>acl:relcl</a>, <a>advcl:relcl</a>, <a>advmod:emph</a>, <a>det:numgov</a>, <a>nummod:gov</a>, <a>obl:arg</a></li>
<li>The following 3 relation types are not used in this corpus at all: <a>clf</a>, <a>compound</a>, <a>goeswith</a></li>
</ul>
